lines.text: How's the hip been since last time?
Since last time I can walk for twenty minutes before the outside of my hip aches.
Er, no, since last time it's more like thirty minutes, I timed it on Sunday.
That's real progress. Are you still sleeping on that side?
No, I've stuck to the other side with a pillow between my knees.
Good. Let me have a look at how you stand on one leg.
Your pelvis dips less than it did, but it still drops on the left when you stand on your right leg.
Avoid crossing your legs and don't stand with all your weight hitched onto one hip, those both squash the tendon.
I do that at the bus stop all the time.
Then that's your homework. Same time in three weeks.
